theThreeQuestionGate.whatFailsWhenARealParcelIsRefused: The key's parcel_record is never instantiated, or never refreshed. In this county the records exist from 2026-09-02, so a refusal means they stop being refreshed and `situsState`/`landUseVintage` then refuse on exactly those keys in the gate (P-350's measured 82). In a NEW county there is no record at all and a missing record is INVISIBLE -- the full-shape ruling, and the reason the correction and the abstention rule both err toward accepting a published parcel key. Live numbers from the P-350 record: 82 keys, 80 of them with the situsState cell and 79 with landUseVintage, the cells a refusal strands.
whatBypassesIt: An unwired caller: `geometryCensusByProp === undefined` reports `instantiationGuard: null` rather than silently passing. Stated, pinned, and the four production call sites all wire it.
The exported single-row UPSERT_RECORD_SQL has no caller (pinned). A raw SQL insert against parcel_record is outside this module.

`retire-phantom-record` is a SEPARATE writer with its own `PHANTOM_GEOMETRY_COUNT_SQL`, which counts ROWS and refuses to retire when the count is 1 -- the same measurement error this lane corrected, in the sibling job. It is NOT changed here (its only authorized target is already retired, and re-pointing its guard is a different row); named as a leave-behind with the measurement that shows the bug.

A county whose published index is mixed or names no real keyspace, or whose roll files literal keys, abstains on the vocabulary leg and falls back to the corrected geometry leg. That is a NAMED limitation, not silent, and it is measured live today only for counties outside the program (48001, 48029, 48113).

leaveBehind: retire-phantom-record.mjs's PHANTOM_GEOMETRY_COUNT_SQL has this lane's exact bug in the other direction: `count(*)` over the same tile-duplicated table, with `count === 1` meaning PHANTOM_IS_A_PARCEL. A phantom carrying ONE tile copy would read as a parcel and refuse to retire; a genuinely multipart one would read as many. One line, same fix (count DISTINCT md5(ST_AsBinary(geom))), and the file also carries an authorized-place-key list that makes it a separate row.

The six program counties' vocabularies are now decided and recorded per run. Three non-program counties measurably ABSTAIN (48029 Bexar files negative ids, 48113 Dallas files alphanumeric ids, 48001 Anderson files dotted ids) -- the abstention is right for them today, and any future county whose ids the two-keyspace classifier cannot describe arrives on the geometry leg, which is P-352's rule with the corrected measure.

A label key shaped like a real numeric id (a bare-digit literal in a numeric county) is STILL undetectable by this leg: shape cannot separate it, and the geometry leg passes it when it carries one part. Named, not papered over; the situs/owner-agreement derivation is the next candidate and the 82's own three null-owner keys show what it costs.

The fill's CAD bind for 48491 is still the published WCAD pair only. `cad_property.prop_id` names all 82 (verified: inCountyRollByPropId true on 82 of 82) and this lane deliberately reads the KEY's shape and never routes a value through it -- adding that binder is P-335's ruled two-namespace decision and a different row.
